name: Despair Domain
body:
You have pledged yourself to crushing your foes with overwhelming despair.

Granted Powers
Touch of Despair (Su)

You cause a creature to become despairing with a melee touch attack. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1).You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. This is a mind-affecting, emotion and despair effect.

Feed on Hopes (Su)

At 8th level, you may further enhance your touch of despair to siphon the morale of your target. If the target was benefiting from any morale bonus they are suppressed for 1 minute per cleric level and you gain 2d8 temporary hit points for the duration. If the target was not benefiting from a morale bonus, the despairing effect is instead extended to 1 min. per cleric level.

Domain Spells: 1st-lesser crushing despair, 2nd-lesser symbol of despair, 3rd–crushing despair (modified), 4th-symbol of despair, 5th-hopeless shadow, 6th-greater crushing despair, 7th-greater symbol of despair, 8th–unholy aura, 9th-aspect of the hope devourer
